# lm-agent-skills

> Public agent-facing skill packs for AI Profit Machine managed agents. Provisioning = skill-pack pull, not a SKU/family/domain/checkout. Mastra = consumer only. Authoring SoT remains the private APM monorepo.

## Packs

- [Marketing Agent (+ Email Drafter)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rapidstartup/lm-agent-skills/main/managed-agents/marketing-agent/SKILL.md): Draft-only Marketing Agent and Email Drafter provider pack for Claude, Grok Bot, Hermes, or a Mastra consumer.
